annotations.title: Create a deck from a Style

description: Build a new deck by crossing a content skeleton (list_skeletons) with a Style (list_styles) — the deck's whole look: palette, fonts, spacing, shape language, decor, atmosphere, motion and transitions. A Style is a Style whether it was curated, generated from a described vibe, or imported from a .pptx / design system / website brand; styleId takes any of them. Generates real imagery matching the Style's art direction by default.

skeletonId.description: Skeleton id from list_skeletons, e.g. pitch

styleId.description: Style id from list_styles — a curated id like `riso-pop` or a saved-style uuid

name: create_deck_from_style
title: Create a deck from a Style
